create.name: Ryumonji Zen Monastery
create.bio:
Ryumonji, the Dragon Gate Temple, is a Soto Zen training monastery in the hills of north-east Iowa near Dorchester, registered as a temple with the Soto school's headquarters in Japan. Its founding abbot, Shoken Winecoff Roshi, studied with Dainin Katagiri Roshi in Minneapolis from 1976, received Dharma transmission from him in 1989 and then spent three years training at Zuioji and Shogoji in Japan. In 2000 a forty-acre farm was given for the monastery, and volunteers and practitioners built it up over the following years: a timber-framed Buddha Hall, an entry gate and bell tower, a kitchen and guest building, and a monks' hall with study quarters completed in 2013. Many of Shoken's Dharma heirs now lead sanghas across the Midwest and beyond.

The public are welcome to sit on Sunday mornings, when zazen is followed by the Heart Sutra and a Dharma talk with discussion, and on Thursday evenings, and a Tuesday book group studies Zen texts; all three can be joined on Zoom. Monthly weekend sesshin bring silent sitting, oryoki meals and work practice, and residential Winter and Summer Ango offer a fuller taste of monastic life. There are no fees; offerings of dana are customary. Recorded talks are shared on SoundCloud.

courses.title: Regular Practice: Sunday and Thursday Zazen, Tuesday Book Group
courses.description: Public practice at the monastery and on Zoom: Sunday mornings of zazen, the Heart Sutra and a Dharma talk with discussion; Thursday evenings of zazen, chanting of Dogen's Fukanzazengi and tea; and a weekly Tuesday evening group reading Zen texts together. Orientation is available for newcomers.

courses.title: Sesshin and Ango
courses.description: Monthly weekend sesshin from Friday evening to Sunday lunch, with many periods of zazen, formal oryoki meals, work practice, a Dharma talk and noble silence, plus residential Winter and Summer Ango practice periods for those who have attended at least one weekend sesshin. Dormitory housing is provided; register through the office.
courses.price: No fees; free-will dana customarily offered

free_resources.title: Ryumonji Online Resources: Sutras and Dharma Talks
free_resources.description: Downloadable chant texts for home and virtual practice, including the Heart Sutra, Fukanzazengi and a virtual chant book, with a link to recorded Sunday Dharma talks streamed free on SoundCloud.
